create_S3Observer: create an S3Observer instance to store experiment results in an AWS S3 bucket with a specified basedir
validate_S3_bucket_name: validate an AWS S3 bucket name against AWS naming rules using the _is_valid_bucket helper function
join_S3_keys: join multiple path segments into a single S3 key string using the s3_join utility function
add_S3_observer_via_cli: add an S3 observer to a Sacred experiment run using the s3_option CLI with s3://bucket/path syntax
save_experiment_metrics_to_S3: log experiment metrics with values, steps, and timestamps to a metrics.json file on S3 using log_metrics
